name: Design Review
description: Design critique and review template for product, UX, architecture, or technical designs.

sections.title: Design Context
sections.instruction: Design name, owner, review stage, problem statement, target users, and linked artifacts if mentioned

sections.title: Review Objective
sections.instruction: Summarize what feedback, decision, or approval was requested from reviewers

sections.title: Design Summary
sections.instruction: Describe the proposed solution, important flows, constraints, assumptions, and tradeoffs

sections.title: Feedback
sections.instruction: List reviewer feedback, categorized by area, severity, and whether it is required or optional

sections.title: Open Questions
sections.instruction: Capture unresolved design, UX, technical, accessibility, content, or research questions

sections.title: Decisions
sections.instruction: List decisions made, approvals granted, rejected options, and rationale

sections.title: Revision Actions
sections.instruction: List design updates, owner, due date, and review path
